name: Bulbasaur
description: Pri narodení mu bolo na chrbát zasadené zvláštne semienko. Rastlina klíči a rastie s týmto Pokémonom.
descriptionEn: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

name: Ivysaur
description: Keď sa cibuľka na chrbte zväčší, zdá sa, že stráca schopnosť stáť na zadných nohách.
descriptionEn: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
description: Rastlina kvitne, keď absorbuje slnečnú energiu. Zostáva v pohybe, aby hľadal slnečné svetlo.
descriptionEn: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Charmander
description: Očividne preferuje horúce miesta. Keď prší, hovorí sa, že zo špičky jeho chvosta tryská para.
descriptionEn: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
description: Keď kýva horiacim chvostom, zvyšuje teplotu na neznesiteľne vysoké úrovne.
descriptionEn: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Charizard
description: Chrlí oheň, ktorý je dostatočne horúci na to, aby roztopil balvany. Je známe, že neúmyselne spôsobuje lesné požiare.
descriptionEn: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

name: Squirtle
description: Po narodení jej chrbát napuchne a stvrdne do ulity. Silne strieka penu z úst.
descriptionEn: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
description: Často sa skrýva vo vode, aby sledoval neopatrnú korisť. Pre rýchle plávanie pohybuje ušami, aby udržal rovnováhu.
descriptionEn: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

name: Blastoise
description: Brutálny Pokémon s tlakovými vodnými tryskami na škrupine. Používajú sa na vysokorýchlostné náčinie.
descriptionEn: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

name: Caterpie
description: Jeho krátke nohy sú zakončené prísavnými podložkami, ktoré mu umožňujú neúnavne stúpať po svahoch a stenách.
descriptionEn: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
description: Tento Pokémon je náchylný na útok, zatiaľ čo jeho ulita je mäkká a odhaľuje jeho slabé a jemné telo.
descriptionEn: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Butterfree
description: V boji máva krídlami pri vysokej rýchlosti, aby vypustil do vzduchu vysoko toxický prach.
descriptionEn: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Weedle
description: Často sa vyskytuje v lesoch, jedia listy. Na hlave má ostré jedovaté žihadlo.
descriptionEn: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

name: Kakuna
description: Takmer neschopný pohybu, tento Pokémon dokáže iba stvrdnúť svoju schránku, aby sa ochránil pred predátormi.
descriptionEn: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Beedrill
description: Lieta vysokou rýchlosťou a útočí pomocou veľkých jedovatých žihadiel na predné končatiny a chvost.
descriptionEn: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Pidgey
description: Bežný pohľad v lesoch a lesoch. Máva krídlami na úrovni zeme, aby nadvihol oslepujúci piesok.
descriptionEn: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
description: Tento Pokémon, ktorý si veľmi chráni svoju rozľahlú teritoriálnu oblasť, bude zúrivo klovať každého votrelca.
descriptionEn: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pidgeot
description: Pri love skĺzne vysokou rýchlosťou po hladine vody, aby odtrhol neopatrnú korisť, ako je MAGIKARP.
descriptionEn: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

name: Rattata
description: Pri útoku niečo hryzie. Malý a veľmi rýchly, na mnohých miestach je to bežný pohľad.
descriptionEn: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Raticate
description: Používa svoje fúzy na udržanie rovnováhy. Zjavne sa spomalí, ak sú odrezaní.
descriptionEn: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

name: Spearow
description: Požiera chrobáky na trávnatých plochách. Musí mávať krátkymi krídlami pri vysokej rýchlosti, aby zostalo vo vzduchu.
descriptionEn: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

name: Fearow
description: So svojimi obrovskými a veľkolepými krídlami sa dokáže udržať vo výške bez toho, aby musel pristáť na odpočinok.
descriptionEn: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

name: Ekans
description: Pohybuje sa ticho a nenápadne. Konzumuje celé vajcia vtákov, ako sú PIDGEY a SPEAROW.
descriptionEn: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

name: Arbok
description: Povráva sa, že ozrutné výstražné značky na jeho bruchu sa v jednotlivých oblastiach líšia.
descriptionEn: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

name: Pikachu
description: Keď sa niekoľko týchto Pokémonov zhromaždí, ich elektrina sa môže nahromadiť a spôsobiť búrky.
descriptionEn: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
description: Jeho dlhý chvost slúži ako uzemnenie na ochranu pred vlastným vysokým napätím.
descriptionEn: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

name: Sandshrew
description: Hrabe hlboko pod zemou na suchých miestach ďaleko od vody. Objavuje sa len pri love potravy.
descriptionEn: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Sandslash
description: Pri ohrození sa stočí do ostnatej gule. Môže sa kotúľať, keď je stočený, aby zaútočil alebo unikol.
descriptionEn: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: Nidoran♀
description: Hoci je malý, jeho jedovaté ostne robia tohto Pokémona nebezpečným. Samica má menšie rohy.
descriptionEn: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
description: Roh ženy sa vyvíja pomaly. Uprednostňuje fyzické útoky, ako sú pazúry a hryzenie.
descriptionEn: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

name: Nidoqueen
description: Jeho tvrdé šupiny poskytujú silnú ochranu. Využíva svoj statný objem na vykonávanie silných pohybov.
descriptionEn: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

name: Nidoran♂
description: Stužuje uši, aby vycítil nebezpečenstvo. Čím väčšie sú jeho rohy, tým silnejší je jeho vylučovaný jed.
descriptionEn: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

name: Nidorino
description: Agresívny Pokémon, ktorý rýchlo útočí. Roh na hlave vylučuje silný jed.
descriptionEn: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Nidoking
description: V boji používa svoj silný chvost, aby rozdrvil, zovrel a potom zlomil kosti koristi.
descriptionEn: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

name: Clefairy
description: Jeho magická a roztomilá príťažlivosť má veľa obdivovateľov. Je vzácny a vyskytuje sa len v určitých oblastiach.
descriptionEn: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Clefable
description: Nesmelá víla Pokémon, ktorá sa vidí málokedy. Utečie a skryje sa vo chvíli, keď zacíti ľudí.
descriptionEn: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Vulpix
description: V čase narodenia má len jeden chvost. Ako starne, chvost sa oddeľuje od špičky.
descriptionEn: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

name: Ninetales
description: Veľmi inteligentný a veľmi pomstychtivý. Chytenie jedného z jeho mnohých chvostov by mohlo mať za následok 1000-ročnú kliatbu.
descriptionEn: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

name: Jigglypuff
description: Keď sa jeho obrovské oči rozžiaria, zaspieva tajomne upokojujúcu melódiu, ktorá uspáva svojich nepriateľov.
descriptionEn: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Telo je mäkké a gumené. Keď sa nahnevá, nasaje vzduch a nafúkne sa do obrovskej veľkosti.
descriptionEn: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

name: Zubat
description: Vytvára kolónie na trvalo tmavých miestach. Používa ultrazvukové vlny na identifikáciu a priblíženie sa k cieľom.
descriptionEn: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

name: Golbat
description: Akonáhle zasiahne, neprestane odčerpávať energiu z obete, aj keď bude príliš ťažká na to, aby lietala.
descriptionEn: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Oddish
description: Cez deň má tvár zaborenú do zeme. V noci sa túla a rozsieva semená.
descriptionEn: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

name: Gloom
description: Tekutina, ktorá mu vyteká z úst, nie sú sliny. Je to nektár, ktorý sa používa na prilákanie koristi.
descriptionEn: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume
description: Čím väčšie sú jeho okvetné lístky, tým viac toxického peľu obsahuje. Jeho veľká hlava je ťažká a ťažko sa drží.
descriptionEn: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Paras
description: Hrabe na vysávanie koreňov stromov. Huby na jeho chrbte rastú čerpaním živín z hostiteľa hmyzu.
descriptionEn: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Parasect
description: Pár hostiteľ-parazit, v ktorom parazit huba prevzal hostiteľskú plošticu. Preferuje vlhké miesta.
descriptionEn: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Venonat
description: Žije v tieni vysokých stromov, kde sa živí hmyzom. V noci ho priťahuje svetlo.
descriptionEn: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Venomoth
description: Prachovité šupiny pokrývajúce jeho krídla sú farebne označené, aby označovali druhy jedu, ktoré má.
descriptionEn: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

name: Diglett
description: Žije asi jeden dvor pod zemou, kde sa živí koreňmi rastlín. Niekedy sa objavuje nad zemou.
descriptionEn: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Dugtrio
description: Tím trojčiat DIGLETT. Vyvoláva obrovské zemetrasenia tým, že sa zaborí 60 míľ pod zem.
descriptionEn: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Meowth
description: Zbožňuje kruhové predmety. Každý večer sa túla ulicami, aby hľadala vypadnuté drobné.
descriptionEn: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Persian
description: Hoci jeho srsť má veľa obdivovateľov, je ťažké ho vychovať ako domáceho maznáčika kvôli jeho vrtkavej podlosti.
descriptionEn: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Psyduck
description: Zatiaľ čo uspáva svojich nepriateľov prázdnym pohľadom, tento prefíkaný Pokémon využije psychokinetické schopnosti.
descriptionEn: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

name: Golduck
description: Často vidieť elegantne plávať pri brehoch jazera. Často sa mýli s japonským monštrom Kappa.
descriptionEn: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

name: Mankey
description: Extrémne rýchlo sa hnevať. V jednom momente by to mohlo byť poslušné a v ďalšom momente by to mohlo byť preč.
descriptionEn: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Primeape
description: Vždy zúrivý a húževnatý. Neopustí prenasledovanie svojho lomu, kým ho nechytia.
descriptionEn: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

name: Growlithe
description: Veľmi chráni svoje územie. Bude štekať a hrýzť, aby odpudil votrelcov zo svojho priestoru.
descriptionEn: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Arcanine
description: Pokémon, ktorý je od minulosti obdivovaný pre svoju krásu. Beží svižne ako na krídlach.
descriptionEn: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

name: Poliwag
description: Jeho novo narastené nohy mu bránia v behu. Zdá sa, že uprednostňuje plávanie ako snahu stáť.
descriptionEn: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Schopný žiť vo vode alebo mimo nej. Keď je mimo vody, potí sa, aby si telo udržalo slizké.
descriptionEn: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Poliwrath
description: Skvelá plavkyňa vpredu kraul aj prsia. Ľahko predbehne najlepších ľudských plavcov.
descriptionEn: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Abra
description: Pomocou svojej schopnosti čítať myšlienky identifikuje hroziace nebezpečenstvo a TELEPORTUJE sa do bezpečia.
descriptionEn: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

name: Kadabra
description: Zo svojho tela vysiela špeciálne alfa vlny, ktoré vyvolávajú bolesti hlavy už len tým, že sú nablízku.
descriptionEn: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

name: Alakazam
description: Jeho mozog dokáže vykonávať superpočítač. Jeho inteligenčný kvocient je údajne 5000.
descriptionEn: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

name: Machop
description: Rád si buduje svaly. Cvičí sa vo všetkých štýloch bojových umení, aby sa stal ešte silnejším.
descriptionEn: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Machoke
description: Jeho svalnaté telo je také silné, že musí nosiť úsporný opasok, aby mohol regulovať svoje pohyby.
descriptionEn: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
description: Pomocou svojich ťažkých svalov vrhá silné údery, ktoré môžu obeť vystreliť za horizont.
descriptionEn: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

name: Bellsprout
description: Mäsožravý Pokémon, ktorý chytá a požiera chrobáky. Používa svoje koreňové nôžky na nasávanie potrebnej vlhkosti.
descriptionEn: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Weepinbell
description: Vypľuje POISONPOWDER, aby znehybnil nepriateľa a potom to dokončí sprejom KYSELINY.
descriptionEn: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

name: Victreebel
description: Hovorí sa, že žije v obrovských kolóniách hlboko v džungli, hoci sa odtiaľ nikto nikdy nevrátil.
descriptionEn: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Tentacool
description: Záplavy v plytkých moriach. Rybári, ktorí ich náhodou ulovia, sú často potrestaní jeho štipľavou kyselinou.
descriptionEn: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

name: Tentacruel
description: Tykadlá sú zvyčajne krátke. Na poľovačkách sú vysunuté, aby chytili a znehybnili korisť.
descriptionEn: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

name: Geodude
description: Nájdené na poliach a horách. Ľudia si ich mýlia s balvanmi a často na ne šliapu alebo zakopnú.
descriptionEn: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Graveler
description: Roluje sa po svahoch, aby sa mohol pohybovať. Prevalí sa cez akúkoľvek prekážku bez spomalenia alebo zmeny smeru.
descriptionEn: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: Golem
description: Jeho balvanovité telo je mimoriadne tvrdé. Ľahko odolá výbuchom dynamitu bez poškodenia.
descriptionEn: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Ponyta
description: Jeho kopytá sú 10-krát tvrdšie ako diamanty. Za krátky čas dokáže pošliapať čokoľvek úplne ploché.
descriptionEn: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

name: Rapidash
description: Veľmi konkurencieschopný, tento Pokémon bude prenasledovať všetko, čo sa rýchlo pohybuje, v nádeji, že s tým bude pretekať.
descriptionEn: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Slowpoke
description: Neuveriteľne pomalé a otrasné. Trvá 5 sekúnd, kým pri útoku pocíti bolesť.
descriptionEn: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
description: O SHELLDER, ktorý je pripevnený na chvost SLOWPOKE, sa hovorí, že sa živí zvyškami hostiteľa.
descriptionEn: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

name: Magnemite
description: Používa antigravitáciu, aby zostal pozastavený. Objaví sa bez varovania a používa THUNDER WAVE a podobné pohyby.
descriptionEn: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

name: Magneton
description: Tvorilo ju niekoľko MAGNEMITE spojených dohromady. Často sa objavujú pri vzplanutí slnečných škvŕn.
descriptionEn: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Farfetch'd
description: Jeho zbraňou je vetvička zelenej cibuľky, ktorú drží. Používa sa podobne ako kovový meč.
descriptionEn: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

name: Doduo
description: Vták, ktorý si svoje slabé lietanie vynahrádza rýchlou nohou. Zanecháva obrovské stopy.
descriptionEn: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Dodrio
description: Používa svoje tri mozgy na realizáciu zložitých plánov. Kým dve hlavy spia, jedna hlava zostáva hore.
descriptionEn: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

name: Seel
description: Vyčnievajúci roh na hlave je veľmi tvrdý. Používa sa na prerazenie cez hrubý ľad.
descriptionEn: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
description: Ukladá tepelnú energiu vo svojom tele. Pláva stabilnou rýchlosťou 8 uzlov aj vo veľmi studených vodách.
descriptionEn: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Grimer
description: Objavuje sa v špinavých oblastiach. Prosperuje tým, že vysáva znečistený kal, ktorý sa odčerpáva z tovární.
descriptionEn: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Muk
description: Husto pokryté špinavým, odporným kalom. Je taký toxický, dokonca aj jeho stopy obsahujú jed.
descriptionEn: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Shellder
description: Jeho tvrdá škrupina odpudzuje akýkoľvek druh útoku. Je zraniteľný iba vtedy, keď je jeho škrupina otvorená.
descriptionEn: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
description: Pri útoku vystrelí rohy rýchlymi salvami. Jeho útroby nikdy nevideli.
descriptionEn: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

name: Gastly
description: Takmer neviditeľný, tento plynný Pokémon zamaskuje cieľ a bez povšimnutia ho uspí.
descriptionEn: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

name: Haunter
description: Pre svoju schopnosť prekĺznuť cez blokové steny sa hovorí, že pochádza z inej dimenzie.
descriptionEn: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.

name: Gengar
description: Za splnu tento Pokémon rád napodobňuje tiene ľudí a smeje sa ich strachu.
descriptionEn: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

name: Onix
description: Ako rastie, kamenné časti jeho tela stvrdnú, aby sa stali podobnými diamantu, ale sfarbené na čierno.
descriptionEn: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

name: Drowzee
description: Uspáva nepriateľov a potom zje ich sny. Občas ochorie z jedenia zlých snov.
descriptionEn: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Hypno
description: Keď upriami oči na nepriateľa, použije kombináciu pohybov PSI, ako je HYPNÓZA a zmätok.
descriptionEn: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

name: Krabby
description: Jeho kliešte nie sú len silnými zbraňami, ale slúžia na rovnováhu pri chôdzi do strán.
descriptionEn: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

name: Kingler
description: Veľký kliešť má drviacu silu 10 000 hp. Jeho obrovská veľkosť ho však znemožňuje používať.
descriptionEn: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

name: Voltorb
description: Zvyčajne sa vyskytuje v elektrárňach. Ľahko si ich pomýlite s POKÉ BALL a zabavili veľa ľudí.
descriptionEn: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

name: Electrode
description: Ukladá elektrickú energiu pod veľmi vysokým tlakom. Často exploduje s malou alebo žiadnou provokáciou.
descriptionEn: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Exeggcute
description: Často mylne považované za vajcia. Pri vyrušení sa rýchlo zhromažďujú a útočia v rojoch.
descriptionEn: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Exeggutor
description: Legenda hovorí, že pri zriedkavých príležitostiach jedna z jeho hláv odpadne a pokračuje ďalej ako EXEGGCUTE.
descriptionEn: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

name: Cubone
description: Pretože nikdy nezloží svoju lebku prilbu, nikto nikdy nevidel skutočnú tvár tohto Pokémona.
descriptionEn: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.

name: Marowak
description: Kosť, ktorú drží, je jeho kľúčovou zbraňou. Kosť hádže šikovne ako bumerang na KO ciele.
descriptionEn: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Keď sa ponáhľa, jeho nohy sa postupne predlžujú. Beží hladko s extra dlhými, šikmými krokmi.
descriptionEn: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

name: Hitmonchan
description: Zatiaľ čo zjavne nič nerobí, strieľa údery v bleskových salvách, ktoré nie je možné vidieť.
descriptionEn: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Lickitung
description: Jeho jazyk môže byť rozšírený ako chameleón. Zanecháva pocit mravčenia, keď olizuje nepriateľov.
descriptionEn: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Koffing
description: Pretože vo svojom tele ukladá niekoľko druhov toxických plynov, je náchylný na výbuch bez varovania.
descriptionEn: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

name: Weezing
description: Tam, kde sa stretnú dva druhy jedovatých plynov, 2 KOFFINGY sa môžu počas mnohých rokov spojiť do WEEZINGU.
descriptionEn: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Jeho masívne kosti sú 1000-krát tvrdšie ako ľudské kosti. Môže ľahko zraziť letiaci príves.
descriptionEn: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Rhydon
description: Chránený brnenou kožou je schopný žiť v roztavenej láve s teplotou 3600 stupňov.
descriptionEn: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

name: Chansey
description: Vzácny a nepolapiteľný Pokémon, o ktorom sa hovorí, že prináša šťastie tým, ktorým sa ho podarí získať.
descriptionEn: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

name: Tangela
description: Celé telo je posiate širokými viničmi, ktoré sú podobné morským riasam. Jeho vinič sa pri chôdzi trasie.
descriptionEn: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.

name: Kangaskhan
description: Dojča sa len zriedka odváži vytiahnuť z matkinho ochranného vaku, kým nemá 3 roky.
descriptionEn: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

name: Horsea
description: Známy tým, že zostreľuje lietajúce chrobáky pomocou presných výtryskov atramentu z hladiny vody.
descriptionEn: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Seadra
description: Dokáže plávať dozadu rýchlym mávaním krídlovitými prsnými plutvami a mohutným chvostom.
descriptionEn: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Goldeen
description: Jeho chvostová plutva sa vlní ako elegantné spoločenské šaty, čo mu dáva prezývku vodná kráľovná.
descriptionEn: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

name: Seaking
description: V jesennom období neresu ich možno vidieť naplno plávať v riekach a potokoch.
descriptionEn: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.

name: Staryu
description: Záhadný Pokémon, ktorý dokáže bez námahy regenerovať akýkoľvek prívesok, ktorý stratí v boji.
descriptionEn: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Starmie
description: Jeho centrálne jadro žiari siedmimi farbami dúhy. Niektorí ľudia si cenia jadro ako drahokam.
descriptionEn: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

name: Mr. Mime
description: Ak ho počas napodobňovania prerušia, širokými rukami obopne páchateľa.
descriptionEn: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

name: Scyther
description: S obratnosťou a rýchlosťou ako ninja môže vytvoriť ilúziu, že existuje viac ako jeden.
descriptionEn: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

name: Jynx
description: Pri chôdzi zvodne vrtí bokmi. To môže spôsobiť, že ľudia budú tancovať v súlade s ním.
descriptionEn: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Electabuzz
description: Bežne sa vyskytujú v blízkosti elektrární, môžu sa zatúlať a spôsobiť veľké výpadky prúdu v mestách.
descriptionEn: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Magmar
description: Jeho telo vždy horí oranžovou žiarou, ktorá mu umožňuje dokonale sa ukryť medzi plameňmi.
descriptionEn: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

name: Pinsir
description: Ak sa mu nepodarí rozdrviť obeť v kliešťoch, otočí ju a silno ju odhodí.
descriptionEn: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

name: Tauros
description: Keď sa zameria na nepriateľa, zúrivo útočí, zatiaľ čo telo bičuje dlhými chvostmi.
descriptionEn: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Magikarp
description: V dávnej minulosti bol o niečo silnejší ako príšerne slabí potomkovia, ktorí existujú dnes.
descriptionEn: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Gyarados
description: Vo voľnej prírode ho možno vidieť len zriedka. Obrovský a krutý, je schopný zničiť celé mestá v zúrivosti.
descriptionEn: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Lapras
description: Pokémon, ktorý bol prenasledovaný takmer na vyhynutie. Dokáže prepraviť ľudí cez vodu.
descriptionEn: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

name: Ditto
description: Schopný skopírovať genetický kód nepriateľa a okamžite sa premeniť na duplikát nepriateľa.
descriptionEn: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

name: Eevee
description: Jeho genetický kód je nepravidelný. Môže zmutovať, ak je vystavený žiareniu z prvkov STONEs.
descriptionEn: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

name: Vaporeon
description: Žije blízko vody. Jeho dlhý chvost je lemovaný plutvou, ktorá je často mylne považovaná za morskú pannu.
descriptionEn: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Jolteon
description: Zhromažďuje záporné ióny v atmosfére, aby vystrelilo 10 000-voltové blesky.
descriptionEn: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

name: Flareon
description: Pri ukladaní tepelnej energie v tele by jej teplota mohla vystúpiť až nad 1600 stupňov.
descriptionEn: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

name: Porygon
description: Pokémon, ktorý pozostáva výlučne z programovacieho kódu. Schopný voľne sa pohybovať v kyberpriestore.
descriptionEn: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

name: Omanyte
description: Hoci už dávno vyhynul, v ojedinelých prípadoch môže byť geneticky vzkriesený z fosílií.
descriptionEn: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Omastar
description: Praveký Pokémon, ktorý vyhynul, keď jeho ťažká škrupina znemožnila chytiť korisť.
descriptionEn: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

name: Kabuto
description: Pokémon, ktorý bol vzkriesený z fosílie nájdenej na dne oceánu pred vekami.
descriptionEn: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

name: Kabutops
description: Jeho elegantný tvar je ideálny na plávanie. Korisť seká pazúrmi a odvádza telesné tekutiny.
descriptionEn: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
description: Divoký, prehistorický Pokémon, ktorý svojimi zúbkovanými pílovitými tesákmi ide po krku nepriateľovi.
descriptionEn: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

name: Snorlax
description: Veľmi lenivý. Len je a spí. Ako jeho okrúhly objem narastá, stáva sa stále lenivejším.
descriptionEn: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Articuno
description: Legendárny vták Pokémon, o ktorom sa hovorí, že sa zjavuje odsúdeným ľuďom strateným v ľadových horách.
descriptionEn: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Zapdos
description: Legendárny vták Pokémon, o ktorom sa hovorí, že sa zjavuje z oblakov pri zhadzovaní obrovských bleskov.
descriptionEn: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

name: Moltres
description: Známy ako legendárny ohnivý vták. Každé mávnutie jeho krídel vytvára oslnivý záblesk plameňov.
descriptionEn: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Dratini
description: Dlho považovaný za mýtického Pokémona až donedávna, keď bola nájdená malá kolónia žijúca pod vodou.
descriptionEn: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Dragonair
description: Mystický Pokémon, ktorý vyžaruje jemnú auru. Má schopnosť meniť klimatické podmienky.
descriptionEn: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

name: Dragonite
description: Extrémne zriedka videný morský Pokémon. Jeho inteligencia sa vraj vyrovná ľudskej.
descriptionEn: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

name: Mewtwo
description: Vytvoril ho vedec po rokoch strašného spájania génov a experimentov s DNA inžinierstvom.
descriptionEn: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Mew
description: Tak vzácny, že je dodnes mnohými odborníkmi považovaný za fatamorgánu. Na celom svete to videlo len pár ľudí.
descriptionEn: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Chikorita
description: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
descriptionEn: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

name: Bayleef
description: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
descriptionEn: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

name: Meganium
description: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.
descriptionEn: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

name: Cyndaquil
description: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.
descriptionEn: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava
description: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.
descriptionEn: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Typhlosion
description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
descriptionEn: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Totodile
description: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
descriptionEn: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

name: Croconaw
description: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
descriptionEn: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

name: Feraligatr
description: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
descriptionEn: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

name: Sentret
description: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
descriptionEn: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

name: Furret
description: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
descriptionEn: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

name: Hoothoot
description: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.
descriptionEn: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

name: Noctowl
description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
descriptionEn: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Ledyba
description: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.
descriptionEn: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
description: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.
descriptionEn: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Spinarak
description: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
descriptionEn: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.
descriptionEn: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Crobat
description: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.
descriptionEn: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
descriptionEn: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Pichu
description: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.
descriptionEn: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

name: Cleffa
description: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.
descriptionEn: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

name: Igglybuff
description: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.
descriptionEn: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.

name: Togepi
description: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.
descriptionEn: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
description: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.
descriptionEn: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

name: Natu
description: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
descriptionEn: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Xatu
description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
descriptionEn: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

name: Mareep
description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.
descriptionEn: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
descriptionEn: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.
descriptionEn: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Bellossom
description: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
descriptionEn: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Marill
description: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.
descriptionEn: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

name: Azumarill
description: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.

name: Sudowoodo
description: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.
descriptionEn: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Politoed
description: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.
descriptionEn: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Hoppip
description: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

name: Skiploom
description: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
descriptionEn: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

name: Jumpluff
description: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
descriptionEn: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

name: Aipom
description: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.
descriptionEn: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Sunkern
description: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
descriptionEn: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

name: Sunflora
description: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
descriptionEn: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

name: Yanma
description: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.
descriptionEn: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Wooper
description: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
descriptionEn: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Quagsire
description: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.
descriptionEn: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

name: Espeon
description: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.
descriptionEn: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

name: Umbreon
description: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.
descriptionEn: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

name: Murkrow
description: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.
descriptionEn: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

name: Slowking
description: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.
descriptionEn: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

name: Misdreavus
description: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.
descriptionEn: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Unown
description: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.
descriptionEn: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

name: Wobbuffet
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
descriptionEn: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Girafarig
description: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.
descriptionEn: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

name: Pineco
description: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.
descriptionEn: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

name: Forretress
description: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.
descriptionEn: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

name: Dunsparce
description: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.
descriptionEn: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

name: Gligar
description: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.
descriptionEn: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

name: Steelix
description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

name: Snubbull
description: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.
descriptionEn: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
description: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.
descriptionEn: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Qwilfish
description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.
descriptionEn: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Scizor
description: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.
descriptionEn: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: Shuckle
description: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.
descriptionEn: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Heracross
description: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Sneasel
description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
descriptionEn: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Teddiursa
description: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.
descriptionEn: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring
description: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.
descriptionEn: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Slugma
description: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.
descriptionEn: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

name: Magcargo
description: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.
descriptionEn: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

name: Swinub
description: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.
descriptionEn: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Piloswine
description: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.
descriptionEn: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

name: Corsola
description: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

name: Remoraid
description: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.
descriptionEn: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

name: Octillery
description: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.
descriptionEn: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

name: Delibird
description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.
descriptionEn: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

name: Mantine
description: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.
descriptionEn: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Skarmory
description: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.
descriptionEn: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Houndour
description: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.
descriptionEn: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndoom
description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.
descriptionEn: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Kingdra
description: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.
descriptionEn: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

name: Phanpy
description: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.
descriptionEn: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

name: Donphan
description: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.
descriptionEn: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

name: Porygon2
description: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.
descriptionEn: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

name: Stantler
description: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.
descriptionEn: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Smeargle
description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
descriptionEn: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Tyrogue
description: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.
descriptionEn: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Hitmontop
description: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.
descriptionEn: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

name: Smoochum
description: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.
descriptionEn: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

name: Elekid
description: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.
descriptionEn: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

name: Magby
description: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

name: Miltank
description: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Blissey
description: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.
descriptionEn: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

name: Raikou
description: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.
descriptionEn: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

name: Entei
description: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
descriptionEn: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

name: Suicune
description: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.
descriptionEn: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

name: Larvitar
description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
descriptionEn: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
description: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.
descriptionEn: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

name: Tyranitar
description: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.
descriptionEn: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

name: Lugia
description: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
descriptionEn: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

name: Ho-Oh
description: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
descriptionEn: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

name: Celebi
description: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Treecko
description: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.
descriptionEn: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

name: Grovyle
description: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

name: Sceptile
description: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.
descriptionEn: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

name: Torchic
description: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.
descriptionEn: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

name: Combusken
description: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.
descriptionEn: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

name: Blaziken
description: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.
descriptionEn: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

name: Mudkip
description: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.
descriptionEn: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

name: Marshtomp
description: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.
descriptionEn: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

name: Swampert
description: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.
descriptionEn: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

name: Poochyena
description: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.
descriptionEn: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

name: Mightyena
description: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.
descriptionEn: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

name: Zigzagoon
description: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.
descriptionEn: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

name: Linoone
description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.
descriptionEn: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Wurmple
description: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.
descriptionEn: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

name: Silcoon
description: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.
descriptionEn: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

name: Beautifly
description: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.
descriptionEn: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

name: Cascoon
description: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.
descriptionEn: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

name: Dustox
description: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.
descriptionEn: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Lotad
description: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.
descriptionEn: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
description: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.
descriptionEn: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
description: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.
descriptionEn: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Seedot
description: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
descriptionEn: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Nuzleaf
description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.
descriptionEn: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Shiftry
description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.
descriptionEn: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Taillow
description: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.
descriptionEn: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.

name: Swellow
description: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.
descriptionEn: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

name: Wingull
description: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.
descriptionEn: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

name: Pelipper
description: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.
descriptionEn: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

name: Ralts
description: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.
descriptionEn: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
description: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.
descriptionEn: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

name: Gardevoir
description: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.
descriptionEn: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

name: Surskit
description: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.
