name: Tranquill
description: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.
descriptionEn: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant
description: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Blitzle
description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
descriptionEn: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
descriptionEn: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Roggenrola
description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.
descriptionEn: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
description: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.
descriptionEn: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Gigalith
description: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.
descriptionEn: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Woobat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
descriptionEn: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.
descriptionEn: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Drilbur
description: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.
descriptionEn: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Excadrill
description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.
descriptionEn: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Audino
description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Timburr
description: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.
descriptionEn: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Gurdurr
description: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.
descriptionEn: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Conkeldurr
description: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.
descriptionEn: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Tympole
description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.
descriptionEn: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.
descriptionEn: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Throh
description: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.
descriptionEn: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

name: Sawk
description: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.
descriptionEn: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

name: Sewaddle
description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
descriptionEn: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
descriptionEn: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
descriptionEn: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Venipede
description: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
descriptionEn: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

name: Whirlipede
description: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.
descriptionEn: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

name: Scolipede
description: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.
descriptionEn: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

name: Cottonee
description: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.
descriptionEn: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Whimsicott
description: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
descriptionEn: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

name: Petilil
description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
descriptionEn: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Lilligant
description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
descriptionEn: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Basculin
description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
descriptionEn: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Sandile
description: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.
descriptionEn: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

name: Krokorok
description: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.
descriptionEn: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

name: Krookodile
description: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.
descriptionEn: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

name: Darumaka
description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.
descriptionEn: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
description: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Maractus
description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.
descriptionEn: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Dwebble
description: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
descriptionEn: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Crustle
description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.
descriptionEn: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

name: Scraggy
description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.
descriptionEn: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
descriptionEn: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Sigilyph
description: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.
descriptionEn: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

name: Yamask
description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.
descriptionEn: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Cofagrigus
description: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.
descriptionEn: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Tirtouga
description: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.
descriptionEn: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

name: Carracosta
description: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

name: Archen
description: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

name: Archeops
description: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.
descriptionEn: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Trubbish
description: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Garbodor
description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.
descriptionEn: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua
description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
descriptionEn: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zoroark
description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
descriptionEn: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Minccino
description: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.
descriptionEn: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

name: Cinccino
description: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.
descriptionEn: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

name: Gothita
description: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.
descriptionEn: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

name: Gothorita
description: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.
descriptionEn: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

name: Gothitelle
description: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.
descriptionEn: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

name: Solosis
description: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.
descriptionEn: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
description: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.
descriptionEn: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
description: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.
descriptionEn: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Ducklett
description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
descriptionEn: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
descriptionEn: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
description: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.
descriptionEn: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
description: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.
descriptionEn: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
description: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.
descriptionEn: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Deerling
description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
descriptionEn: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
descriptionEn: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

name: Emolga
description: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Karrablast
description: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.
descriptionEn: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

name: Escavalier
description: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.
descriptionEn: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

name: Foongus
description: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.
descriptionEn: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Amoonguss
description: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.
descriptionEn: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Frillish
description: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
description: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
descriptionEn: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Alomomola
description: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
descriptionEn: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

name: Joltik
description: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.
descriptionEn: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

name: Galvantula
description: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.
descriptionEn: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Ferroseed
description: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.
descriptionEn: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
description: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.
descriptionEn: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Klink
description: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.
descriptionEn: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

name: Klang
description: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.
descriptionEn: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

name: Klinklang
description: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.
descriptionEn: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

name: Tynamo
description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
descriptionEn: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
descriptionEn: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Elgyem
description: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

name: Beheeyem
description: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.
descriptionEn: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

name: Litwick
description: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.
descriptionEn: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
description: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.
descriptionEn: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
description: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.
descriptionEn: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

name: Axew
description: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.
descriptionEn: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

name: Fraxure
description: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.
descriptionEn: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

name: Haxorus
description: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.
descriptionEn: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

name: Cubchoo
description: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.
descriptionEn: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

name: Beartic
description: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.
descriptionEn: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Cryogonal
description: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.
descriptionEn: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

name: Shelmet
description: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.
descriptionEn: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Accelgor
description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.
descriptionEn: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Stunfisk
description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
descriptionEn: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Mienfoo
description: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
descriptionEn: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.
descriptionEn: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Druddigon
description: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
descriptionEn: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Golett
description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk
description: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.
descriptionEn: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

name: Pawniard
description: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.
descriptionEn: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
description: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.
descriptionEn: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Bouffalant
description: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Rufflet
description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
descriptionEn: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Braviary
description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
descriptionEn: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Vullaby
description: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.
descriptionEn: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Mandibuzz
description: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.
descriptionEn: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Heatmor
description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.
descriptionEn: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Durant
description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
descriptionEn: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Deino
description: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.
descriptionEn: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
description: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
descriptionEn: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Hydreigon
description: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.
descriptionEn: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

name: Larvesta
description: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.
descriptionEn: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

name: Volcarona
description: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

name: Cobalion
description: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.
descriptionEn: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

name: Terrakion
description: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.
descriptionEn: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

name: Virizion
description: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.
descriptionEn: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

name: Tornadus
description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
descriptionEn: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

name: Thundurus
description: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
descriptionEn: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

name: Reshiram
description: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
descriptionEn: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Zekrom
description: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.
descriptionEn: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

name: Landorus
description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
descriptionEn: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

name: Kyurem
description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
descriptionEn: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

name: Keldeo
description: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.
descriptionEn: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

name: Meloetta
description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
descriptionEn: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Genesect
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Chespin
description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.
descriptionEn: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

name: Quilladin
description: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.
descriptionEn: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

name: Chesnaught
description: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
descriptionEn: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Fennekin
description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.
descriptionEn: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
descriptionEn: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.
descriptionEn: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Froakie
description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
descriptionEn: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
descriptionEn: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

name: Greninja
description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
descriptionEn: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Bunnelby
description: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.
descriptionEn: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby
description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.
descriptionEn: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Fletchling
description: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
descriptionEn: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

name: Fletchinder
description: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.
descriptionEn: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

name: Talonflame
description: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.
descriptionEn: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

name: Scatterbug
description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
descriptionEn: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
description: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
descriptionEn: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
description: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.
descriptionEn: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Litleo
description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.
descriptionEn: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
description: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.
descriptionEn: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Flabébé
description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
descriptionEn: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Floette
description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
descriptionEn: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

name: Florges
description: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
descriptionEn: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

name: Skiddo
description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
descriptionEn: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
descriptionEn: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Pancham
description: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.
descriptionEn: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Pangoro
description: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
descriptionEn: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Furfrou
description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
descriptionEn: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Espurr
description: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.
descriptionEn: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Meowstic
description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.
descriptionEn: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Honedge
description: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.
descriptionEn: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
descriptionEn: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
descriptionEn: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Spritzee
description: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.
descriptionEn: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
description: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.
descriptionEn: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Swirlix
description: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.
descriptionEn: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Slurpuff
description: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.
descriptionEn: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Inkay
description: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.
descriptionEn: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Malamar
description: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.
descriptionEn: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Binacle
description: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.
descriptionEn: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

name: Barbaracle
description: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.
descriptionEn: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

name: Skrelp
description: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.
descriptionEn: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

name: Dragalge
description: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.
descriptionEn: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

name: Clauncher
description: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.
descriptionEn: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

name: Clawitzer
description: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.
descriptionEn: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

name: Helioptile
description: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
descriptionEn: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
description: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.
descriptionEn: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Tyrunt
description: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum
description: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.
descriptionEn: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Amaura
description: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.
descriptionEn: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus
description: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.
descriptionEn: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Sylveon
description: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
descriptionEn: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Hawlucha
description: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.
descriptionEn: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Dedenne
description: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Carbink
description: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.
descriptionEn: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Goomy
description: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.
descriptionEn: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Sliggoo
description: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.
descriptionEn: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Goodra
description: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
descriptionEn: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Klefki
description: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.
descriptionEn: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

name: Phantump
description: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.
descriptionEn: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
description: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.
descriptionEn: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
descriptionEn: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
descriptionEn: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Bergmite
description: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
descriptionEn: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Avalugg
description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
descriptionEn: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Noibat
description: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.
descriptionEn: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

name: Noivern
description: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.
descriptionEn: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Xerneas
description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
descriptionEn: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Yveltal
description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
descriptionEn: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Zygarde
description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
descriptionEn: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Diancie
description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
descriptionEn: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Hoopa
description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.
descriptionEn: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Volcanion
description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
descriptionEn: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Rowlet
description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
descriptionEn: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Dartrix
description: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
descriptionEn: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Decidueye
description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
descriptionEn: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Litten
description: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.
descriptionEn: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

name: Torracat
description: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.
descriptionEn: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

name: Incineroar
description: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.
descriptionEn: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

name: Popplio
description: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.
descriptionEn: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

name: Brionne
description: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.
descriptionEn: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

name: Primarina
description: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.
descriptionEn: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

name: Pikipek
description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
descriptionEn: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
descriptionEn: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
descriptionEn: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Yungoos
description: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
descriptionEn: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
descriptionEn: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Grubbin
description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
descriptionEn: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Charjabug
description: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.
descriptionEn: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
description: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.
descriptionEn: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Crabrawler
description: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
descriptionEn: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

name: Crabominable
description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
descriptionEn: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Oricorio
description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
descriptionEn: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Cutiefly
description: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.
descriptionEn: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Ribombee
description: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.
descriptionEn: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Rockruff
description: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Lycanroc
description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.
descriptionEn: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Wishiwashi
description: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.
descriptionEn: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Mareanie
description: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.
descriptionEn: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

name: Toxapex
description: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.
descriptionEn: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

name: Mudbray
description: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.
descriptionEn: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

name: Mudsdale
description: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.
descriptionEn: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

name: Dewpider
description: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
descriptionEn: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
description: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
descriptionEn: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Fomantis
description: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.
descriptionEn: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

name: Lurantis
description: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
descriptionEn: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

name: Morelull
description: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
descriptionEn: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

name: Shiinotic
description: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.
descriptionEn: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

name: Salandit
description: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.
descriptionEn: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
description: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.
descriptionEn: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Stufful
description: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.
descriptionEn: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
description: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.
descriptionEn: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Bounsweet
description: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
descriptionEn: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
description: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.
descriptionEn: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Tsareena
description: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.
descriptionEn: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

name: Comfey
description: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

name: Oranguru
description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
descriptionEn: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Passimian
description: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
descriptionEn: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Wimpod
description: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.
descriptionEn: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

name: Golisopod
description: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.
descriptionEn: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

name: Sandygast
description: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.
descriptionEn: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

name: Palossand
description: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Pyukumuku
description: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
descriptionEn: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Type: Null
description: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.
descriptionEn: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
descriptionEn: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Minior
description: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
descriptionEn: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Komala
description: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
descriptionEn: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Turtonator
description: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
descriptionEn: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Togedemaru
description: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
descriptionEn: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Mimikyu
description: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
descriptionEn: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Bruxish
description: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
descriptionEn: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Drampa
description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
descriptionEn: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Dhelmise
description: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.
descriptionEn: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Jangmo-o
description: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.
descriptionEn: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

name: Hakamo-o
description: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
descriptionEn: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Kommo-o
description: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
descriptionEn: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Tapu Koko
description: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
descriptionEn: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Tapu Lele
description: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
descriptionEn: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Tapu Bulu
description: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.
descriptionEn: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

name: Tapu Fini
description: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
descriptionEn: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

name: Cosmog
description: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.
descriptionEn: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

name: Cosmoem
description: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.
descriptionEn: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

name: Solgaleo
description: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.
descriptionEn: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

name: Lunala
description: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.
descriptionEn: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

name: Nihilego
description: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
descriptionEn: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

name: Buzzwole
