description: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
descriptionEn: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Pheromosa
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
descriptionEn: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Xurkitree
description: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
descriptionEn: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

name: Celesteela
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
descriptionEn: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Kartana
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
descriptionEn: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Guzzlord
description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
descriptionEn: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Necrozma
description: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.
descriptionEn: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Magearna
description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
descriptionEn: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Marshadow
description: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

name: Poipole
description: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
descriptionEn: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Naganadel
description: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
descriptionEn: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Stakataka
description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
descriptionEn: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Blacephalon
description: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
descriptionEn: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Zeraora
description: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.
descriptionEn: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

name: Meltan
description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
descriptionEn: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Melmetal
description: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

name: Grookey
description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
descriptionEn: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
description: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.
descriptionEn: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
descriptionEn: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Scorbunny
description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
descriptionEn: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
descriptionEn: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
description: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
descriptionEn: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Sobble
description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
descriptionEn: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Drizzile
description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
descriptionEn: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Inteleon
description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
descriptionEn: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Skwovet
description: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.
descriptionEn: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Greedent
description: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
descriptionEn: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Rookidee
description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
descriptionEn: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Corvisquire
description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
descriptionEn: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

name: Corviknight
description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.
descriptionEn: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

name: Blipbug
description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
descriptionEn: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
descriptionEn: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.
descriptionEn: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Nickit
description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
descriptionEn: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
descriptionEn: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Gossifleur
description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
descriptionEn: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
descriptionEn: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Wooloo
description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
descriptionEn: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
descriptionEn: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Chewtle
description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
descriptionEn: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Yamper
description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
descriptionEn: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
descriptionEn: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Rolycoly
description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
descriptionEn: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
descriptionEn: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
description: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
descriptionEn: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Applin
description: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
descriptionEn: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Flapple
description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
descriptionEn: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Appletun
description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
descriptionEn: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Silicobra
description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
descriptionEn: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
descriptionEn: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Cramorant
description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
descriptionEn: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Arrokuda
description: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.
descriptionEn: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
descriptionEn: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Toxel
description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
descriptionEn: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxtricity
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
descriptionEn: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
descriptionEn: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
descriptionEn: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Clobbopus
description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.
descriptionEn: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
descriptionEn: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Sinistea
description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
descriptionEn: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Polteageist
description: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
descriptionEn: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Hatenna
description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
descriptionEn: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hattrem
description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
descriptionEn: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
description: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
descriptionEn: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Impidimp
description: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
descriptionEn: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
description: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
descriptionEn: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
descriptionEn: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Obstagoon
description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
descriptionEn: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Perrserker
description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
descriptionEn: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Cursola
description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
descriptionEn: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Sirfetch’d
description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
descriptionEn: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Mr. Rime
description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
descriptionEn: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Runerigus
description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
descriptionEn: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Milcery
description: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
descriptionEn: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Alcremie
description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
descriptionEn: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Falinks
description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
descriptionEn: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Pincurchin
description: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.
descriptionEn: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Snom
description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
descriptionEn: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
descriptionEn: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Stonjourner
description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
descriptionEn: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Eiscue
description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Indeedee
description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
descriptionEn: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Morpeko
description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
descriptionEn: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Cufant
description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
descriptionEn: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Dracozolt
description: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
descriptionEn: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Arctozolt
description: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

name: Dracovish
description: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
descriptionEn: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

name: Arctovish
description: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
descriptionEn: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

name: Duraludon
description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
descriptionEn: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Dreepy
description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
descriptionEn: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drakloak
description: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
descriptionEn: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Dragapult
description: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
descriptionEn: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Zacian
description: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

name: Zamazenta
description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Eternatus
description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
descriptionEn: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Kubfu
description: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
descriptionEn: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

name: Urshifu
description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
descriptionEn: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Zarude
description: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
descriptionEn: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Regieleki
description: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.
descriptionEn: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.

name: Regidrago
description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Glastrier
description: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
descriptionEn: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Spectrier
description: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
descriptionEn: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

name: Calyrex
description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
descriptionEn: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

name: Wyrdeer
description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
descriptionEn: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Kleavor
description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
descriptionEn: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Ursaluna
description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
descriptionEn: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Basculegion
description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
descriptionEn: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Sneasler
description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
descriptionEn: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Overqwil
description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
descriptionEn: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Enamorus
description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
descriptionEn: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Sprigatito
description: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
descriptionEn: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
description: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
descriptionEn: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Meowscarada
description: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.
descriptionEn: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

name: Fuecoco
description: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.
descriptionEn: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
description: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
descriptionEn: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
description: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
descriptionEn: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Quaxly
description: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
descriptionEn: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxwell
description: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
descriptionEn: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaquaval
description: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
descriptionEn: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

name: Lechonk
description: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Oinkologne
description: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.
descriptionEn: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

name: Tarountula
description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.
descriptionEn: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Spidops
description: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.
descriptionEn: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

name: Nymble
description: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
descriptionEn: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

name: Lokix
description: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.
descriptionEn: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

name: Pawmi
description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
descriptionEn: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
description: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
descriptionEn: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
description: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
descriptionEn: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Tandemaus
description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
descriptionEn: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.
descriptionEn: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Fidough
description: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.
descriptionEn: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Dachsbun
description: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.
descriptionEn: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

name: Smoliv
description: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Dolliv
description: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
descriptionEn: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

name: Arboliva
description: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Squawkabilly
description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.
descriptionEn: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Nacli
description: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.
descriptionEn: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

name: Naclstack
description: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
descriptionEn: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
description: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.
descriptionEn: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Charcadet
description: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
descriptionEn: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Armarouge
description: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Ceruledge
description: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
descriptionEn: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

name: Tadbulb
description: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
descriptionEn: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Bellibolt
description: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.
descriptionEn: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

name: Wattrel
description: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
descriptionEn: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Maschiff
description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
descriptionEn: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Mabosstiff
description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.
descriptionEn: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Shroodle
description: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
descriptionEn: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Grafaiai
description: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
descriptionEn: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Bramblin
description: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
descriptionEn: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
description: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
descriptionEn: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Toedscool
description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
descriptionEn: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
description: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
descriptionEn: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Klawf
description: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Capsakid
description: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
descriptionEn: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Scovillain
description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
descriptionEn: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Rellor
description: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
descriptionEn: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Rabsca
description: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
descriptionEn: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Flittle
description: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
descriptionEn: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
description: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
descriptionEn: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Tinkatink
description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
descriptionEn: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
descriptionEn: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Wiglett
description: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
descriptionEn: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

name: Wugtrio
description: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.
descriptionEn: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Bombirdier
description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.
descriptionEn: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Finizen
description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
descriptionEn: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
description: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
descriptionEn: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

name: Varoom
description: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
descriptionEn: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
description: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
descriptionEn: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Cyclizar
description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.
descriptionEn: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

name: Orthworm
description: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Glimmet
description: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
descriptionEn: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
description: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
descriptionEn: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Greavard
description: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.
descriptionEn: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
description: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
descriptionEn: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Flamigo
description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
descriptionEn: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Cetoddle
description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
descriptionEn: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.
descriptionEn: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Veluza
description: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
descriptionEn: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Dondozo
description: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.
descriptionEn: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Tatsugiri
description: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
descriptionEn: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Annihilape
description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
descriptionEn: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Clodsire
description: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.
descriptionEn: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Farigiraf
description: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
descriptionEn: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

name: Dudunsparce
description: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
descriptionEn: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Kingambit
description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
descriptionEn: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Great Tusk
description: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.
descriptionEn: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Scream Tail
description: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
descriptionEn: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Brute Bonnet
description: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
descriptionEn: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Flutter Mane
description: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.
descriptionEn: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Slither Wing
description: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Sandy Shocks
description: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.
descriptionEn: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Iron Treads
description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
descriptionEn: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Bundle
description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
descriptionEn: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Iron Hands
description: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Jugulis
description: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
descriptionEn: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Iron Moth
description: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.
descriptionEn: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Iron Thorns
description: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
descriptionEn: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Frigibax
description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
description: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
descriptionEn: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

name: Baxcalibur
description: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
descriptionEn: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Gimmighoul
description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
descriptionEn: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Gholdengo
description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
descriptionEn: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Wo-Chien
description: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
descriptionEn: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Chien-Pao
description: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
descriptionEn: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Ting-Lu
description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
descriptionEn: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Chi-Yu
description: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.
descriptionEn: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Roaring Moon
description: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.
descriptionEn: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Iron Valiant
description: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
descriptionEn: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Koraidon
description: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.
descriptionEn: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

name: Miraidon
description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
descriptionEn: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Walking Wake
description: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.
descriptionEn: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

name: Iron Leaves
description: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
descriptionEn: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Dipplin
description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
descriptionEn: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Poltchageist
description: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
descriptionEn: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
description: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
descriptionEn: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Okidogi
description: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
descriptionEn: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Munkidori
description: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
descriptionEn: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Fezandipiti
description: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Ogerpon
description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
descriptionEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Archaludon
description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.
descriptionEn: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Hydrapple
description: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
descriptionEn: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Gouging Fire
description: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
descriptionEn: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

name: Raging Bolt
description: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
descriptionEn: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

name: Iron Boulder
description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
descriptionEn: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Crown
description: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
descriptionEn: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Terapagos
description: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.
descriptionEn: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Pecharunt
description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
